string.text: Complete a Latin square while satisfying all inequality signs between neighbouring cells.
Place each digit once per row and column and satisfy every inequality.
Puzzle solved. Victory has been recorded for this attempt.
Arrows — cursor Enter — ink / pencil 1–6 — digit Shift/Ctrl + arrow — clue
Changing difficulty will reset the active Unequal game. Change difficulty?
The active Unequal game will be lost. Start a new puzzle?

Fill every cell with a digit from 1 to the grid size. Every digit must occur exactly once in each row and exactly once in each column. A victory is recorded only when the entire grid is correct and every inequality is satisfied.

The number at the pointed end of a sign must be smaller than the number at its open end. Some valid relations are deliberately not shown. Clicking a sign merely marks it as checked or unchecked; it does not change the puzzle.

Enable Pencil, select a cell, and press a digit to add or remove a small note. Pencil marks are only reminders and are ignored when the game checks the solution. Enter toggles the keyboard cursor between final digits and pencil marks.

Click a cell, then use the on-screen keypad. Erase cell clears its final digit or notes. Arrow keys move the cursor; 1–6 enters a digit, and Space, 0, Backspace or Delete clears the selected cell. Click a clue to grey it out, or use Shift/Ctrl with an arrow toward that clue. Undo is shown only when a move can be undone.

Closing the PDA or leaving the tab keeps the exact board for the current session. Loading a save resets the active board but keeps the selected difficulty. After victory the attempt is locked: Undo and Restart are hidden, and only a new random puzzle creates another attempt.

F5/F9 and menu loading preserve the exact active game during the current game process. The reward is fixed when an attempt starts and cannot be rerolled by loading. Easy gives no reward. A completed board cannot be replayed; New game creates a new attempt.
